US says pause followed an "Iranian government request"; Iran denies direct talks. Pakistan is mediating. Previous 5-day pause (Mar 23) was violated hours later by strikes on Isfahan and Khorramshahr.

Situation Brief — Day 27

Active strikes/alerts:
  • Israeli/US airstrikes on Iranian targets continue. Iran, Hezbollah and Hamas launch missile/rocket counterstrikes into Israel. Northern border with Lebanon active daily.

  • Trump announced SECOND pause on US strikes targeting Iran’s energy sector — 10 days, deadline Apr 6, 2026 8:00 PM ET. White House says pause per “Iranian government request.”

  • Pakistan mediating between Washington and Tehran.
  • IAEA chief to inspect Iranian nuclear sites under an interim US–Iran understanding.

Northern border / Lebanon

  • Daily Hezbollah activity. Reuters: Israel and Lebanon discussing US-backed plan to transfer parts of southern border control to the Lebanese Army. Netanyahu to discuss Trump plan in cabinet.

Military & air defenses

  • TASS reports a successful test of the Golden Dome missile-defense system (Russian claim).
  • Commercial flight scans show continued military airlift activity in the region (C-130s logged).

Regional moves

  • Iran allowing Hormuz passage for some friendly countries (Russia, India, China); blocking others.
  • Bloomberg: UK, France, Germany ready to lift relevant Iran sanctions — signals possible European recalibration.

Gaza & civilians

  • AP: Israeli strike killed a teen en route to school in Gaza. Continued shortages endanger chronic patients.

🟢 Good News

  • Golden Dome test reported successful. IAEA inspections agreed. A formal pause window exists and Pakistan is mediating.
Threat assessment: Escalating
